question: Can a two-line bounded shared-response controller with periodic backpressure supply a candidate-policy-independent exact prefix/cycle relation, and does the service observer add admissions against a per-line tight completion observer with the identical exact prefix?
unit: Deterministic source/controller parameter case; policy/phase queries are correlated calculations, not independent workload samples.
source: Two fixed zero-byte lines/tags 64 and 128; one pending request per client. A send enqueues its client, marks pending, and schedules the next poll at send+q. A scheduled poll while pending clears the scheduled event and sets wait. A response clears pending; if waiting, clear wait and schedule c+q; otherwise preserve the outstanding scheduled poll. A poll precedes a same-tick response callback, so ties are resolved explicitly rather than rejected.
controller: FIFO request queue capacity two, fixed A-before-B simultaneous enqueue order. At each p boundary, grant at most the oldest request iff R0 is empty at that tick's entry; capture its immutable client/byte snapshot into R0 and cancel its line counter. After grant, emit old R1 iff sink ready, then transfer R0 to R1 iff R1 is empty. Emitted response callback is last. Both response registers hold one snapshot, remain unchanged when blocked, and cannot overwrite. Transfer is specified at p boundaries; transfer at other ticks would be behaviorally inert under these guards.
tick_order: optional valid-only zero-byte WU on each line
decrement enabled line counters at t%P=phi
source polls and FIFO enqueue A then B
boundary grant using entry R0 occupancy
boundary emit old R1 iff ready
boundary transfer R0 to empty R1
entry: Each line's contract starts immediately after that line's guaranteed initial successful grant/capture, with no earlier WU for that line. Later zero-byte WUs are independently optional per line per tick. There is no revocation, refill, payload mutation, memory request, watchdog or other invalidation.
cycle_key: At beginning of tick: t mod lcm(p,r), each client's next-poll delay or None, pending and wait bits, FIFO client order, occupied client identities in R0/R1. Concrete monotonically increasing request IDs are quotiented to client identity because at most one request/client is pending and an ID is never reused while live.
cycle_extraction: Stop at first repeated complete key. Record every case including cap failures without replacing it. Let a,b be first and repeated key times, d=b-a. Continue at least two further d periods to obtain response and next-same-client grant for every service in [a,b), checking translated event sequences. Prefix edges start at initial per-line grant and have s<a. Cycle edges have a<=s<b. Edge triples are (successful grant s, matching emission c, next same-line grant h).

policy_grid.line_policy: Same physical (K,P,phi) on both dedicated line counters; global safety is minimum over both lines.

routes.exact_service: Identical exact finite-prefix check plus gcd-lifted recurrent service envelope on both lines.
routes.strong_completion: The SAME exact finite-prefix check, then separately tight J=max(c-s), A=max(h-c), actual completion residues C0 for EACH line's recurrent relation; min across lines. No gain may be attributed to forgetting line identity.
routes.storage: Full d master is universally supported. A predeclared compressed g=d/gcd(d,3) is a secondary posthoc diagnostic, explicitly retaining unsupported queries/fallback; prospective g*=lcm{gcd(P,d):P in1..4p} is reported separately.

correctness: Independent event simulator with different representation recomputes all forty complete control traces and prefix/cycle relations.
Check queue bound, response snapshot conservation, unique pending ownership, no overwrite, finite key translation, actual response stalls and shared queue contention.

Every physical phase's minimizing edge is checked by literal countdown and a one-WU negative execution through that failed grant, using previously no WUs. Positive all-WU proof is first-failure induction plus monotone rearm; sampled WUs are not treated as infinite-word coverage.
Independent arithmetic based only on integer decrement counts reconstructs every K/P/phi admission and fair baseline outcome.
Retain all zero/negative outcomes and all failures; do not change or select cases after results.
outputs: finite control trace digests and extraction costs in tick/key/event counts
prefix/cycle triples with line IDs and translation
timing: No runtime performance or hardware benefit in this initial study. Native timed workflow, if subsequently attempted, requires a separately frozen timing protocol and scheduling with root before running. Extraction/build/prefix/projection/lookup/fallback operation counts are exact computational costs, not elapsed time.
scope: New explicitly specified bounded digital controller only; not native HUSH, byte-exact gem5 MemTest, arbitrary-payload coherence, memory-system throughput, application or hardware validation. No remotes, downloads, process termination or manuscript/figure/publication edits. Historical results remain unchanged.
